quotes.text: Learn how to accept FPX, a common payment method in Malaysia.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: FPX is only available to businesses based in Malaysia.
This doc refers to a *Legacy* (Technology that's no longer recommended) feature that’s no longer available in the latest version of Stripe.js.
The PaymentIntent will transition from `requires_action` to `succeeded`.
For compliance reasons, your FPX funds settle in a separate `fpx` balance on your account.

findings: November 7, 2026 capture is only an index with Checkout, Elements and Mobile links (new raw lines 5-15). The May 3, 2026 capture contains full Checkout and legacy Elements guidance and a short Mobile Payment Element pointer (old raw lines 8-529). Diff lines 3-532 show capture-shape removal of detail, not deprecation or altered payment policy.

May Checkout variant describes single-use Malaysia/MYR redirect, payment mode only, no setup/subscription, same-currency one-time line items, hosted versus embedded Session URLs, and a required six-field confirmation page derived from the Charge through the Checkout Session's PaymentIntent (old raw lines 18-37, 45-122). Current source lines 13-20 mostly preserve this, but its summary omits the mobile pointer and should not make the November index behavioral authority.

May legacy Elements route requires Malaysia-based business, Dashboard enablement and FPX terms, MYR PaymentIntent created server-side, fpxBank Element and confirmFpxPayment client-side with return_url; the bank redirect and URL query parameters are not themselves a success signal (old raw lines 140-156, 171-190, 248-311). The fpxBank feature is explicitly legacy and described as unavailable in latest Stripe.js (old raw lines 144, 248); this is a dated feature-specific statement, not deprecation of all Elements or FPX. The old mobile section is only a pointer to Android/iOS/React Native Mobile Payment Element (old raw lines 519-529), not full native flow evidence.

Old test outcomes distinguish requires_action to succeeded after successful authentication, requires_payment_method after failed authentication, and requires_confirmation for named confirmation errors (old raw lines 313-328). Fulfillment should listen for payment_intent.succeeded server-side rather than rely on client callback (old raw lines 330-346). The Charge confirmation fields are available via payment_intent.succeeded; direct PaymentIntent.charges.data access is explicitly limited to API version 2022-08-01 or older (old raw lines 438-462). Current source line 20 needs this version/path qualification if expanded.

The source's Elements amount line 25 says min RM2/max RM30,000, matching old parameter table line 178, but old invalid_amount row says transactions must be greater than RM2 and less than RM30,000 (old raw line 493). Preserve reciprocal uncertainty at exact endpoints rather than asserting inclusivity. Current source line 13 and old raw lines 501-517 describe a separate fpx balance and Connect source_type; a successful PaymentIntent does not prove a particular balance is available or a payout occurred.

The related bank-redirects concept claims FPX subscriptions through send_invoice (wiki/concepts/stripe-bank-redirects.md:32-34), while old Elements guide says FPX is single-use, no recurring/additional payments and not supported with Stripe Billing (old raw line 156). Checkout's no subscription mode (old raw line 32) is narrower, but the Billing/send_invoice claims need reciprocal dated qualification; November index does not resolve them.

The mapped source summary lines 11-33 omits the dated merchant/Connect access gates. May Elements requires Dashboard FPX enablement and acceptance of FPX terms, says FPX is only available to businesses based in Malaysia, and scopes Custom-account support as beta (old raw lines 148-156). The short May Mobile section repeats enablement/terms and Malaysia-business requirement (old raw lines 521-529). Customer geography Malaysia is a distinct Checkout condition (old raw line 22), not a substitute for merchant location. Treat these as May path-scoped claims, not renewed by new raw lines 9-15.

The mapped source frontmatter lacks canonical_url (source lines 1-9). Require exactly canonical_url: https://docs.stripe.com/payments/fpx/accept-a-payment from both pinned Source URL lines (old raw line 1; new raw line 1). Keep the May 3 detailed raw/date and add the November 7 three-link navigation raw separately in frontmatter and Raw Sources (source lines 4-7, 43-45); this is baseline schema/provenance repair, not a semantic provider change.
historical_claims_to_preserve: May 3, 2026 Checkout Malaysia/MYR, single-use redirect, one-time payment mode, confirmation-page six Charge fields, 60-day refund/no dispute: old raw lines 18-37, 109-132.

May 3, 2026 legacy fpxBank integration, precise client/server flow, test-state transitions, manual redirect requires_action/redirect_to_url and post-payment events: old raw lines 140-156, 171-334, 370-426.

May 3, 2026 FPX logo/bank selection/terms and confirmation-page requirements, API-version-conditional Charge access, 18-bank table, errors and separate fpx balance/Connect source_type: old raw lines 428-517.

May 3, 2026 mobile pointer to Mobile Payment Element on Android, iOS and React Native, plus Dashboard enablement/terms and Malaysia-business gate: old raw lines 519-529; no full native integration details in that capture.

May 3, 2026 legacy Elements merchant gate and Custom-account beta caveat: FPX enabled in Dashboard, terms accepted, Malaysia-based business, and Custom accounts in beta (old raw lines 148-156). Customer geography Malaysia is separately stated for Checkout (old raw line 22).
conflicts: Old amount parameter table calls RM2 minimum and RM30,000 maximum (old raw line 178), while invalid_amount row says strictly greater than RM2 and less than RM30,000 (old raw line 493); current source line 25 repeats inclusive-sounding limits. Exact boundary eligibility remains unresolved.

Bank-redirects concept says FPX subscriptions can use send_invoice (wiki/concepts/stripe-bank-redirects.md:33-34), while old FPX Elements guide says single-use, no recurring/additional payment and not supported with Stripe Billing (old raw line 156). Checkout no subscription mode (old raw line 32) is separate. Add reciprocal dated/scope caveats; do not infer a November change.

Source/FPX concept call a confirmation page mandatory (wiki/sources/source-stripe-fpx-accept-payment.md:13,20; wiki/concepts/stripe-fpx.md:47), which is supported by May Checkout and legacy Elements requirements (old raw lines 109-122, 428-447), but its application to the short Mobile pointer or unread November mobile variant is not established.
unresolved_questions: Current content at the linked November Checkout, Elements and Mobile variants (new raw lines 13-15) was not captured here; current native steps, exact amount endpoint limits and Billing/send_invoice support remain unverified.

findings: Add November base-URL index as dated navigation-only raw provenance while retaining May detailed source (source lines 4-7,43-45); mention the old short Mobile Payment Element pointer separately from Checkout and legacy Elements (old raw lines 519-529); qualify source line 25 amount endpoints against old raw lines 178 and 493; preserve API-version-specific Charge access (old raw lines 438-462).

Add the missing canonical_url field in source frontmatter lines 1-9 with exactly https://docs.stripe.com/payments/fpx/accept-a-payment (old raw line 1; new raw line 1); retain May 3 raw/date and add the November 7 index raw separately in frontmatter and Raw Sources.

Add May path-scoped merchant access gates omitted by source lines 11-33: FPX Dashboard enablement and terms acceptance, Malaysia-based business, and Custom-account beta in legacy Elements (old raw lines 148-156); Mobile repeats enablement/terms and merchant location (old raw lines 521-529). Distinguish Checkout customer geography Malaysia (old raw line 22) from merchant location; do not treat November variant links as current eligibility verification.
conflicts: Old raw amount table and invalid_amount row disagree on inclusive RM2/RM30,000 endpoints (old raw lines 178,493). Related bank-redirects concept send_invoice subscription statement (wiki/concepts/stripe-bank-redirects.md:33-34) conflicts with old raw line 156's no recurring/Billing statement; no new variant detail resolves it.
source_assessments.reason: The November capture only adds variant navigation, while the mapped source lacks exact canonical_url provenance and May-dated Malaysia merchant/Custom-account gates in addition to baseline scope and amount-endpoint qualifications.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/fpx/accept-a-payment, the complete November capture establishes only FPX's Malaysian context and links to Checkout, Elements and Mobile variants (new raw lines 5-15). The May capture describes a single-use MYR bank redirect for Malaysian customers, with a separate merchant gate: FPX must be enabled in the Dashboard, its terms accepted, and the business based in Malaysia; legacy Elements says Custom-account support was beta (old raw lines 22-37, 148-156, 521-529). Checkout uses payment-mode one-time Sessions, while legacy Elements uses a server-created PaymentIntent, client fpxBank Element and confirmFpxPayment with return_url (old raw lines 45-103, 171-190, 248-311). Six post-payment confirmation fields come from the Charge; server-side payment_intent.succeeded is the business-action signal, whereas a redirect, return or requires_action is not success (old raw lines 109-122, 313-334, 428-462). FPX funds have a separate balance and Connect source_type, without any payout guarantee (old raw lines 501-517). source-stripe-fpx-accept-payment.md omits those May merchant/Custom-account gates in lines 11-33 and needs the mobile pointer, amount-endpoint and API-version qualifications plus November provenance.
answers.Q2: The difference at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/fpx/accept-a-payment is navigation/capture presentation: new raw lines 9-15 list variants, while old raw lines 8-529 contain full Checkout and legacy Elements detail and a short Mobile pointer. No substantive payment, fee or platform change is established. source-stripe-fpx-accept-payment.md needs its missing canonical_url field set to that exact URL (source lines 1-9; old raw line 1; new raw line 1), retaining the May 3 detailed raw/date and adding the November 7 three-link index as separate provenance. Preserve May-dated Malaysia-based merchant eligibility, Dashboard enablement, FPX terms and legacy Elements Custom-account beta; distinguish these merchant/Connect gates from Checkout's Malaysia customer geography (old raw lines 22, 148-156, 521-529). Also retain MYR/payment-only, six Charge fields, legacy fpxBank warning, test states, 18 banks and separate fpx balance (old raw lines 18-37, 109-122, 248-328, 428-529). Qualify source line 25's RM2/RM30,000 endpoints because the old amount table and invalid_amount row disagree (old raw lines 178, 493). Reciprocally warn that bank-redirects concept send_invoice subscription support conflicts with old Elements no-recurring/Billing text (old raw line 156); Checkout no-subscription mode is narrower. Charge access differs by API version 2022-08-01, and the November links prove no current eligibility or payout.
